from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to the task."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    stated_cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action stated in the document (e.g., '合同纠纷', '侵权责任纠纷')")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the legal case (e.g., '民事', '行政', '刑事')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
